notes: Mutation from the strongest erasing/color/crop evidence while respecting the baseline_reference showing no augmentation is strongest. Keeps the successful EuroSAT prior of mild crop plus bidirectional flips, trims crop probability/magnitude slightly below the best erasing baseline to reduce low-data distortion, and retains only rare light erasing as the specific regularizer that ranked best; color jitter is reduced to a very small optional spectral perturbation rather than a main branch.
